name: Configuration Binding
description: Declares a configuration input required by Site code without storing its runtime value.
purpose: Gives Codex and deployment tooling one place to understand required public/server/secret configuration while keeping actual values outside the manifest.

options.label: Public
options.description: Non-secret configuration explicitly allowed in public browser bundles.

options.label: Server Only
options.description: Non-secret configuration available only to trusted server/build execution.

options.label: Secret
options.description: Sensitive value resolved from a secure secret store. The value is never written into the manifest.

fields.description: Whether the implementation cannot operate as intended without the binding.
Environment IDs where the binding is required.

validationRules.description: Configuration keys must be unique within one Site Manifest.
The Manifest declares key metadata only. Runtime values are never stored here.
A secret exposure binding must never be copied into browser-visible variables, HTML, logs or generated static data.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
